center.title: Import Center
center.description: Bulk-create records from an Excel or CSV file.
center.noPermission: You don't have permission to import any records yet.

students.label: Students
students.description: Bulk-admit students, with up to two guardians attached per row.

staff.label: Staff & Users
staff.description: Bulk-create staff accounts with a role each. Passwords are never imported — every account gets a password-reset email.

guardians.label: Guardians
guardians.description: Attach guardians to students already in the system, by admission number — a guardian matched by email is reused, not duplicated.

departments.label: Departments
departments.description: Set up subject-grouping departments in bulk — useful when first configuring a new school.

grade-levels.label: Grade Levels
grade-levels.description: Bulk-create the grades your school teaches, with each one's promotion sequence.

sections.label: Sections
sections.description: Bulk-create sections (classes students are admitted into) for the current academic year, optionally assigned a room.

subjects.label: Subjects
subjects.description: Bulk-create subjects, optionally linked to a department by its code.

rooms.label: Rooms
rooms.description: Bulk-create physical rooms with capacity and type.

logs.title: Import Logs
logs.description: Every bulk-import attempt across the school, including previews that were never confirmed.
logs.emptyDescription: Files you import will be logged here, with the option to undo.
logs.undoDialogDescription: This removes the {{count}} record(s) it created from "{{fileName}}". Records this import only updated are never touched, and anything with dependents created since will be skipped and reported. This can't be redone from here — the removed records go to trash the same way a normal delete does.
logs.undoWarning: {{deleted}} record(s) undone. {{blockedCount}} could not be undone: {{blockedList}} — something else now depends on them.
